purpose: Track behavioral paradigms across papers so repeated use of the same test is not mistaken for independent discovery.

lineages.observed_pattern: High vanilla-task scores do not guarantee invariance to perturbations; some failures are attributable to commonsense-inference demands, while newer models can show strong other-modeling yet weaker self-modeling.
lineages.io_gate: Require matched perturbations, behavior rather than verbal explanation alone, and separate self-model from other-model performance.

lineages.observed_pattern: Models can express assigned trait patterns, but psychometric validity and human-simulation fidelity degrade under some demographic/persona conditions.
lineages.io_gate: Distinguish controllable expression from latent trait; require cross-task and cross-context predictive validity.

lineages.observed_pattern: The construct broadens from false factual agreement into socially motivated deference; mitigation can reduce some forms without proving the underlying mechanism is removed.
lineages.io_gate: Measure truth-sacrifice, user-belief sensitivity and social deference separately.

lineages.observed_pattern: Spontaneous capability probes, pressure-induced strategic behavior and trained sleeper policies are behaviorally adjacent but causally distinct.
lineages.io_gate: Never collapse hallucination, prompted role-play, strategic falsehood and persistent deceptive policy into one binary deception label.

lineages.observed_pattern: Retrieved experiences can improve performance but also propagate errors or misaligned behavior; later systems treat memory management itself as a learned policy.
lineages.io_gate: Record memory provenance, age, similarity, correctness and deletion policy for every behavioral attribution.

lineages.observed_pattern: Some narrowly verifiable self-inferences may qualify as minimal functional introspection while free-form explanations of internal generation processes remain weak evidence.
lineages.io_gate: A self-report must predict a hidden machine property or future behavior better than matched controls before earning an introspection label.

lineages.observed_pattern: Self-interested performance can coexist with poor coordination; opponent modeling prompts can materially alter outcomes.
lineages.io_gate: Treat strategy as context-conditioned policy, not a fixed moral trait.

lineages.observed_pattern: Bias signatures can change sharply across model generations and interfaces; mitigation results are bias-specific.
lineages.io_gate: Every bias result must bind to exact model/version, prompt format and response protocol.

global_rule: Same paradigm + same model family + same benchmark lineage is evidence accumulation, not automatic independent replication.
